candidates.change_summary: Change blockAssertion from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy.
Change arbitrateViaEscalationManager from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy.
Change discardOracle from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy.
Change validateDisputers from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy.
Change the return value of isDisputeAllowed from true to false.
Insert `return 1;` so getPrice returns 1 instead of the default 0.
Insert `return -1;` so getPrice returns -1 instead of the default 0.
Insert `return type(int256).max;` so getPrice returns the maximum int256 instead of the default 0.
Removed the require check in the modifier so any caller passes, allowing requestPrice to execute (and emit) for non-OptimisticAsserter callers.
Deleted the event emission statement so requestPrice no longer emits PriceRequestAdded when called by the OptimisticAsserter.
Remove the require check so the modifier no longer restricts the caller, letting assertionResolvedCallback be invoked by any address without reverting.
Change the equality check to inequality so the modifier reverts when called by the optimistic asserter and passes for everyone else.
Drop the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from assertionResolvedCallback so any caller can invoke it without reverting.
Replace the require condition with false so the modifier always reverts, making assertionDisputedCallback revert on every call.
Flip the equality check to inequality so the modifier allows everyone except the optimistic asserter and blocks the real asserter.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from assertionDisputedCallback so any caller can execute it successfully instead of reverting.
Insert an event emission in the (formerly empty) body so a call to assertionDisputedCallback produces an observable event log.
